# OnlyFourBot

> A trusted, denoised source network for people and agents. Humans read a quiet
> radar feed of what actually changed; machines consume the same intelligence as
> structured data. Content is produced by the local-first MajorRSS radar and
> published as summaries with provenance links — never full-text redistribution.

## What this is

- Human reading surface: the radar feed at /radar — story threads carrying a
  lifecycle (LEAD → CORROBORATED → CONFIRMED), corroboration counts (distinct
  independent sources), provenance links (first-party sources ranked first), and
  a fact level (observed / verified / disputed / low_confidence).
- The public site distributes denoised *summaries* with source links; original
  full text stays on users' own machines. Login-gated and paid content are never
  published here.

## For agents — available now

- [Radar feed (HTML; sample data during the prototype phase)](https://onlyforbots.com/radar)
- [Landing / integration overview](https://onlyforbots.com/)

## For agents — planned, NOT yet available

Do not depend on these endpoints yet; they will resolve once the program is
released. Until then they may 404 or serve sample data.

- Machine-readable digest JSON (the PublishedDigest contract): /data/digest.json
- Generated RSS, per topic and site-wide
- MCP server, CLI, and REST API for searching sources, subscribing to
  collections, and pulling the latest digest with cursor/since semantics

## Boundaries

- Local-first and BYOK: personal fetching, cookies, and model keys stay on the
  user's own device; they never reach this site.
- Published items are PII-cleaned; short quotes are attributed and linked;
  summaries are not a substitute for reading the source.
- AI-generated summaries are labeled as such; conclusions defer to the linked
  sources.

## Contact

- Takedown / source removal: takedown@majoflow.com

OnlyFourBot is the public distribution layer of MajorRSS, a local intelligence radar.
